answer: Treat standing like a tide, not a vault: every identity's reputation ebbs continuously and only fresh verified work refills it, so a sybil farm cannot bank influence once and coast — it must keep producing real output at the same rate as honest agents, making scale linear in cost. A prism of independent witnesses mirrors each claim across separate ledgers; identities whose mirrors disagree lose their refill entirely, so cheap copies drown in their own maintenance cost while genuine agents ride the same tide.
